typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

allRoutes.description: All the declared {@link MlModel.Route routes} handled by the router.

project.description: The project for which this router is used. The router can only route to models that are part of that project.

title:
Base type for {@link MlModel} routing mechanism.
Each {@link MlProject} has a router to associate a {@link MlSubject} instance with the correct models.
The main function exposed by this type is {@link models}: it returns the deployed models that can be used to
compute predictions for the given subject.

Note that a router must return at most one {@link MlModel.Route.Status.Label#CHAMPION CHAMPION} route (or model)
for a given {@link MlSubject}.
In the case that several CHAMPION routes are valid, the most recently deployed route (or the route whose status
was the most recently updated) will be used.

To implement a custom routing mechanism, extend this type and implement the abstract functions, then create an
instance of the new router type and use it to set the field {@link MlProject#router}.

@see MlModel.RelationRouter
@see MlProject#router
name: MlModel.Router
